title: Demotion gate — a live strategy goes back to paper when any trigger fires
status: pre-registered and armed; no strategy is live yet

triggers.name: Skill reversal
triggers.rule: after >= 30 settled live signals: flat-stake live ROI < -5% AND one-sided t-test p < 0.10 that skill <= 0
triggers.rationale: flat-stake measure stops staking luck from hiding signal decay

triggers.name: Closing-line collapse
triggers.rule: mean closing-line value < 0 over the last 50 settled live signals
triggers.rationale: beating the close is the least noisy skill marker

triggers.name: Drawdown
triggers.rule: flat-stake bankroll drawdown > 25% from peak over any rolling 50 settled signals
triggers.rationale: tail risk the CI does not show

triggers.name: Source integrity breach
triggers.rule: any week in which > 10% of the strategy's input rows lose official sourcing (gate G-01 breach)
triggers.rationale: data integrity is a single source of truth

on_fire: strategy status set to paper (from live)
entry on the What changed page + flagged-for-review if disputed
re-qualification: 4 weeks AND >= 30 paper signals at flat stake beating 0 ROI with CI covering nothing worse than -5%
process.authority: pipeline gates job (data/pipeline/gates.json) — owner notified, veto via repository issue

threshold_provenance: Thresholds are defaults pre-registered by this session per the owner instruction 'define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper'; numeric values are proposals on the suggestion board (S-20) and may be amended before any strategy goes live. Blank is never filled: triggers needing missing inputs (D-2) stay flagged until the input exists.
